HEDERA LINK.

Wireless audio research for processional events and moving sound systems.

Moving audio. Connected systems.

Hedera Link explores uncompressed stereo audio transport over licence-free 5 GHz IP links, using embedded audio endpoints and route-aware RF planning.

Designed around the route.

The research considers changing line of sight, vibration, moving platforms and dense RF environments. Hardware, antenna coverage and operational recovery are treated as one system.
